access_detail: DOI 10.6075/J00865GT -> library.ucsd.edu/dc/object/bb3387869t: resolve_doi raises Manual (unsupported host), so the registry route cannot download as written. The object RDF lists two components: /1/1.zip and /2/1.zip. Direct URLs work (HTTP 200 application/zip, no Range support): https://library.ucsd.edu/dc/object/bb3387869t/_1_1.zip (321.8 MB) and _2_1.zip (281.0 MB); the `/download` suffix also works but would make list_direct name the file 'download', which kind() reads as 'other'. DataCite description: component 1 = micro-SPC protist multi-class training images (5x darkfield), component 2 = mini-SPC copepod / non-copepod images (0.5x darkfield); CC BY 4.0.
